texts.value: On ligand binding, forms a receptor complex consisting of two type II and two type I transmembrane serine/threonine kinases. Type II receptors phosphorylate and activate type I receptors which autophosphorylate, then bind and activate SMAD transcriptional regulators. Receptor for activin A, activin B and inhibin A (PubMed:17911401, PubMed:10652306). Mediates induction of adipogenesis by GDF6 (By similarity)

Part of a complex consisting of MAGI2/ARIP1, ACVR2A, ACVR1B and SMAD3 (By similarity). Interacts with MAGI2/ARIP1 (By similarity). Interacts with type I receptor ACVR1 (PubMed:17911401). Interacts with BMP7 (PubMed:12667445). Interacts with TSC22D1/TSC-22 (PubMed:21791611). Interacts with activin A/INHBA (PubMed:10652306)
Belongs to the protein kinase superfamily. TKL Ser/Thr protein kinase family. TGFB receptor subfamily
